change_summary.evidence_independence: Full independent-flat saturation credit additionally requires complete canonical evidence-lineage identifiers.
change_summary.dependence_rule: Rounds sharing any canonical ancestry cannot both be in the fully independent credited subset.
change_summary.count_rule: Use an exact maximum pairwise-disjoint lineage subset up to lineage_exact_limit; above the limit report a deterministic conservative lower bound and mark it non-exact.
change_summary.unknown_lineage_rule: Incomplete/unknown lineage receives no full evidence-independence credit and is reported as partial identification.
change_summary.reopening_rule: Any new retained semantic object still reopens the flat sequence regardless of lineage.

open_residuals.summary: Source head, base, synthesized integration revision/tree and actual executed revision remain distinct coordinates.
Aliases or versions of the same underlying evidence artifact can evade exact string lineage overlap.
Shared ancestry proves non-independence but does not identify dependence strength or fractional information contribution.

saturation.reason: Seven non-duplicate semantic objects/residuals were retained; no flat counter advances.

promotion.rule: main must remain starting_main_sha until the exact final candidate SHA passes the unchanged test workflow and compare confirms protected evaluator/configuration inputs remain unchanged

next_ai.positive: After successful exact-SHA validation and non-forced fast-forward, finalize this receipt with the tested SHA/run and final main SHA. Then freeze META_N024 subject-identity known-answer worlds before any active change.
next_ai.null: If lineage-aware tests add no behavior beyond the incumbent in an externally relevant case, retain the null and do not invent stronger independence claims.
next_ai.refuted: If the disjoint-lineage rule creates a false saturation or rejects a known full-independent world, keep main unchanged and preserve the counterexample.
next_ai.partial_id: If canonical lineage identity is unresolved, use PARTIALLY_IDENTIFIED_LINEAGE and move to META_N025 rather than guessing aliases.
next_ai.blocked: If exact candidate CI or protected-input comparison cannot be observed, record CANNOT_CHECK and do not promote.
next_ai.transport: On transient GitHub/API failure preserve the candidate branch and retry the same frozen benchmark later.
